niches.notes: High ticket, emergency intent, rarely a usable mobile site.
Cares about looking credible, slow to update sites.
Visual trade, almost always a weak gallery.

disqualify_if: the site is a Facebook, Instagram or Yelp page rather than a real website
the site is a national franchise or a directory, not an independent local business
the site was clearly redesigned recently and already scores well
there is no contact route at all, so there is nobody to send a draft to
